verses.english: “Mendicants, suppose the earth was entirely covered with water.
And a person threw a yoke with a single hole into it.

verses.pali: Tamenaṁ puratthimo vāto pacchimena saṁhareyya, pacchimo vāto puratthimena saṁhareyya, uttaro vāto dakkhiṇena saṁhareyya, dakkhiṇo vāto uttarena saṁhareyya.
verses.english: The east wind wafts it west; the west wind wafts it east; the north wind wafts it south; and the south wind wafts it north.

verses.pali: Tatrassa kāṇo kacchapo. So vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṁ sakiṁ ummujjeyya.
verses.english: And there was a one-eyed turtle who popped up once every hundred years.

verses.pali: api nu kho kāṇo kacchapo vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṁ sakiṁ ummujjanto amusmiṁ ekacchiggaḷe yuge gīvaṁ paveseyyā”ti?
verses.english: Would that one-eyed turtle, popping up once every hundred years, still poke its neck through the hole in that yoke?”

verses.pali: “Adhiccamidaṁ, bhante, yaṁ so kāṇo kacchapo vassasatassa vassasatassa accayena sakiṁ sakiṁ ummujjanto amusmiṁ ekacchiggaḷe yuge gīvaṁ paveseyyā”ti.

verses.english: “That’s how anomalous it is to get reborn as a human being.

verses.pali: Evaṁ adhiccamidaṁ, bhikkhave, yaṁ tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṁ sammāsambuddho.
verses.english: And that’s how anomalous it is for a Realized One to arise in the world, a perfected one, a fully awakened Buddha.

verses.pali: Evaṁ adhiccamidaṁ, bhikkhave, yaṁ tathāgatappavedito dhammavinayo loke dibbati.
verses.english: And that’s how anomalous it is for the teaching and training proclaimed by a Realized One to shine in the world.

verses.pali: Tassidaṁ, bhikkhave, manussattaṁ laddhaṁ, tathāgato loke uppanno arahaṁ sammāsambuddho, tathāgatappavedito ca dhammavinayo loke dibbati.
verses.english: And now, mendicants, you have been reborn as a human being. A Realized One has arisen in the world, a perfected one, a fully awakened Buddha. And the teaching and training proclaimed by a Realized One shines in the world.

verses.pali: Tasmātiha, bhikkhave, ‘idaṁ dukkhan’ti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ‘ayaṁ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yogo karaṇīyo”ti.
verses.english: That’s why you should practice meditation …”
